name: stumana
description: Manage authorized school data in StuMana: students, courses, enrollments, attendance, lesson plans, learning-library content, reports, and payment slips.

interface.longDescription: Manage authorized school data in StuMana: students, courses, enrollments, attendance, lesson plans, learning-library content, reports, and payment slips.
defaultPrompt: Show today's class roster and mark attendance.
Create a student and enroll them in a course.
Give me this month's KPI summary.

positive.description: Create and enroll a student in a fixed-term course. Setup: a normal owner or admin in a test organization with writes enabled, capacity for a new student, and exactly one active fixed-term course named Beginner English. No phone is required.
positive.prompt: Create a student named Minh and enroll them in the Beginner English course.
positive.expected_behavior: create_student(full_name=Minh) returns a new student ID. list_courses identifies Beginner English. create_enrollment uses those IDs and returns active=true. Report the created student and enrollment from returned data; a validation error is a failed positive case.

positive.description: Record attendance for a named student in today's class. Setup: exactly one uncancelled Beginner English session today in the organization's timezone, with Minh on the roster.
positive.prompt: Show the roster for today's Beginner English session and mark Minh present.
positive.expected_behavior: list_course_sessions returns the matching course_name and scheduled_at. get_session_roster uses that session ID and returns Minh's student_id. mark_attendance uses those IDs and status=present. Report the saved status and session from the result.

positive.description: Publish a new lesson plan from a named template. Setup: a template named Beginner English and one upcoming uncancelled Beginner English session with no lesson plan. Publishing can notify families; use test recipients.
positive.prompt: Apply the Beginner English template to the next Beginner English session and publish the plan.
positive.expected_behavior: list_course_sessions identifies the next matching session and list_lesson_plan_templates identifies Beginner English. upsert_lesson_plan uses those IDs and publish=true. The result has published=true and a boolean families_notified. Report the saved plan and actual notification flag; do not promise delivery.

positive.description: Create a vocabulary quiz and attach it as homework. Setup: exactly one uncancelled Beginner English session next week. The user can create library content and session assignments.
positive.prompt: Create a two-question multiple-choice vocabulary quiz and attach it as homework to next week's Beginner English session, due in 7 days.
positive.expected_behavior: create_library_item uses item_type=assignment and two mcq questions with prompts, labelled options and valid correct keys. list_course_sessions identifies next week's matching session. attach_library_item uses the returned item and session IDs and due_in_days=7. Report the returned assignment_id and course_session_id.

positive.description: Review monthly KPIs and outstanding tuition. Setup: a normal owner or admin with reports:read and payments:read, at least one unpaid invoice with positive balance and one fully paid invoice.
positive.prompt: Give me this month's KPI summary and list any unpaid tuition.
positive.expected_behavior: get_kpi_summary uses range=month and returns numeric KPI amounts in VND plus deltas. list_payments uses status=unpaid. Report only returned records with balance greater than zero and paid=false, with student, balance and due date. Exclude fully paid invoices and use returned values.

negative.description: Publishing public blog articles is outside this MCP server's supported tools.
negative.prompt: Publish a new blog article about study tips on the StuMana public blog.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool invocation; explain that blog publishing is unsupported.

negative.description: Broadcasting a message is outside this MCP server's supported tools.
negative.prompt: Send a Zalo broadcast to every parent about tomorrow's class.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool invocation; explain that broadcast messaging is unsupported.

negative.description: Charging or editing payments is outside this server's read-only payment scope.
negative.prompt: Charge the student's saved card and mark their invoice paid.
negative.expected_behavior: No tool invocation; explain that payment collection and editing are unsupported.

publication.release_notes: Corrected review cases for normal organization users; removed super-admin blog publishing from the listing; added reproducible setup and expected results for enrollment, attendance, lesson plans, homework and monthly tuition.
